notes: Both articles governing a noun with a following genitive pronoun (τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ, τὰ … ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ) are unrepresented under rule 20's displacement, while the articles before ἥλιος and φῶς take their own 'the' under rule 19 — the contrast rule 20 itself draws.
'he was transfigured' and 'did shine' head on the lexical verbs, not the subject or the auxiliary (rules 9, 17).
Variant SBLGNT.MAT.17.2.v001 (r00-base, r01) covers ἐγένετο only; both readings are rendered by 'became', so nothing in the alignment turns on it.
